evidence: GetStockLevelsUseCase.execute() calls this.catalog.getAllProducts() and maps each product to a StockLevel DTO. This is query orchestration, which belongs in the application layer.
Stock figures come from domain methods: this.catalog.getTotalStock, getReservedStock and getAvailableStock. The use case does not compute available stock itself.
The file has no database, HTTP or framework calls.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: This is an application-layer use case. It asks the domain Catalog for products and stock figures, then maps them into a read-model DTO (StockLevel). The stock math (total, reserved, available) is delegated to domain methods instead of being computed here. The file has no persistence, transport or framework code, and it adds no business rules of its own. Its responsibilities fit the application layer.
